label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off because E1 is a national database record of a past accident inside the area. Although it is unchecked indirect evidence (reliability class 6), the national criteria designate such a record as a clearance target after the first visit, and this programme provides no technical survey. E2 does not establish safe use or evidence of EO.
flags: E1's date, accuracy and location have not been verified on the ground; this recommendation follows the national criterion for the recorded accident, not confirmation of contamination.
E2 reports that meeting attendees were recent arrivals and could not describe prior land use; it provides no history of safe use.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: Unchecked database accident record suggests possible EO but its location and reliability have not been verified on the ground; national criteria make it a clearance target after the first visit.

E2.quote: The people at the community meeting had moved to the vereda in the last 5 years and could not say how the area was used before.
E2.note: The attendees are firsthand only about their recent move, and do not know the area's prior use; this says neither that EO is present nor that the area was safely used.
